files: Who Gives ad · DR06 · Donor Note: David
LOTUS illustrations · September Spirit font · Watsi brand guide. Lato for all text. Navy #2E2844 is text only, never a background. Cyan #11BAED, light cyan #D3EDFA, yellow #FFCC33.
tech: Donor's own phone audio note (audio/mp4). No picture: the picture is kinetic type and Watsi's pulsing waveform on the Who Gives gradient.
1080×1080 square, 30 fps. The type and the gradient fill the whole square: no vertical 9:16 panel or border inside it.

The page draws graphics and caption clips at 1080×1920. Put them on the square timeline at 100% and move them up or down until the text sits where the row says (width is the same 1080). Keep every word inside the square with a margin.
Top banner from the approved ad design (Sonam, 1 Oct: CTA as a top banner on 1:1). Same words as the latest approved version. Letters spaced so r and n never touch (learn, earned, owned).
Light noise-floor clean only. Never re-voice. No music, no other sound under the donor.

Who Gives pop-up words: Lato Bold, white with a soft shadow, word by word, no box, no highlight, no jumpy animation. Never drop out. Every Watsi written by hand (the transcript writes WOTC). The caption clips sit about 880 px down the square when centred.
H.264 MP4, 1080×1080. One file. The vertical is a separate item.
checklist: Frame 1 is the hook text on the gradient. Not the Who Gives card.
The Who Gives card says “Hear from David” and “Watsi donor since 2016”.
No vertical panel or border inside the square.
Top banner letters spaced; banner inside the square.
Credit is first name and year only. No surname or company.
Watsi with a capital W; watsi.org lowercase.

decisions.b: The brief's ask names a dollar amount. Money stays off this page, so the ask lives in the approved banner and the end card says “give today”. Nick confirms the banner words.
The Deadline column is empty. Nick sets it.
